brand.description: The product's brand name as generally recognized by consumers. If no brand is available for a product, do not supply any value. Maximum 70 characters. Example: Intel

category_path.description: The product's category path as used in the merchant's webshop. Include the full and most detailed category and separate the segments with ' > '. Maximum 750 characters. Example: Electronics Store > Computers & Tablets > Desktops

color.description: Color to be shown to the end customer (max 64 characters). Example: Denim blue

global_trade_item_number.description: The product's Global Trade Item Number (GTIN). Common types of GTIN are EAN, ISBN or UPC. Exclude dashes and spaces, where possible. Maximum 50 characters. Example: 735858293167

manufacturer_part_number.description: The product's Manufacturer Part Number (MPN), which - together with the brand - uniquely identifies a product. Only submit MPNs assigned by a manufacturer and use the most specific MPN possible. Maximum 70 characters. Example: BOXNUC5CPYH

size.description: Size to be shown to the end customer (max 64 characters). Example: 4
